主要内容: Apple (AAPL -0.26%) reported fiscal fourth-quarter earnings for fiscal 2018, with services revenue hitting a new quarterly record of $10 billion. iPhone revenue increased 29% to $37.2 billion, despite flat unit volumes at 46.9 million. iPhone average selling prices rose to $793, up from $618 a year ago. Apple also sold 9.7 million iPads and 5.3 million Macs, achieving a new all-time record in quarterly Mac revenue. The company added 30 million paid subscriptions, bringing its total to 330 million. Net income came in at $14.1 billion, or $2.91 per share. Apple repurchased $19.4 billion in shares, with cumulative repurchases reaching $239 billion. The company also declared a quarterly dividend of $0.73 per share. Apple plans to stop reporting unit sales starting in the December quarter, shifting focus to financial results and services growth. CFO Luca Maestri stated that unit sales are less relevant today due to the breadth of the company's portfolio and the emphasis on customer experience and financial performance over unit counts.
